definitions.explanation: A doctor with an outstanding reputation for diagnosis and treatment. The word carries admiration and is used of individuals people seek out by name, often by word of mouth.

examples.japanese: {名医|めいい}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: He is known as a renowned doctor.

examples.japanese: {評判|ひょうばん}の{名医|めいい}に{診|み}てもらった。
examples.english: I had a much-talked-about specialist examine me.

examples.japanese: {全国|ぜんこく}から{患者|かんじゃ}が{訪|おとず}れるほどの{名医|めいい}だと{聞|き}いている。
examples.english: I hear he is such a renowned doctor that patients come to him from all over the country.

notes:
The prefix {名|めい} means "famous, master-class" and forms a productive set of praise words: {名医|めいい}, {名人|めいじん} (master), {名作|めいさく} (masterpiece), {名選手|めいせんしゅ} (star player).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名医|めいい}を{探|さが}す: to look for a good doctor
- {評判|ひょうばん}の{名医|めいい}: a doctor with a great reputation
- {名医|めいい}に{巡|めぐ}り{会|あ}う: to be lucky enough to find a great doctor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {専門医|せんもんい}: specialist — a factual qualification, not praise
- {主治医|しゅじい}: attending physician — the doctor in charge of your case
- やぶ{医者|いしゃ}: quack — the opposite, a doctor considered incompetent
